Class OfferTile

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.model.board.OfferTile
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class OfferTile extends Object implements Serializable
A single slot on the offer track. Players place their totem here during TotemPlacementState to declare which card rows they will draw from and how many cards they may draw. A tile can grant food instead of cards (givesFood), in which case the action is resolved automatically.

    • OfferTile

      public OfferTile(String id, Player player, Map<Row,Integer> moves, boolean givesFood)
      Creates an offer tile.
      Parameters:
      id - unique identifier of the tile
      player - the player currently occupying this tile, or null if free
      moves - for each Row, how many cards may be drawn from it if this tile is chosen
      givesFood - true if choosing this tile grants food instead of card draws
